segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I had us down to talk through the workspace analytics package for the Omaha team, 38 seats to start, and a May 20 go-live. Is that still the right shape?

segments.text: That's right. We may add five more people in June, but for launch it's 38. The main thing is I need the invoice to hit after June 1, not in May.

segments.text: Yep, that's doable. The order form can be signed in May with billing start date June 1. First invoice would be for $1,748.00 monthly, plus the one-time onboarding at $2,400.

segments.text: Okay. And the onboarding, that's two admin trainings and the data import, correct?

segments.text: Correct. Two 60-minute admin sessions, import of up to 24 months of CSV history, and we include the launch checklist. If you want end-user training, that's optional, $600 for a group session.

segments.text: That's fine. I also need net 30 on invoices and the PO number on every invoice. PO is 44719.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, PO 44719 and net 30. The billing contact I have is ap@northlineparts.com, with you copied. Still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. Send the order form to me and Marcus for signature. If he signs by Friday, can we still hit May 20 for kickoff?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, Friday signature keeps May 20 open. I'll send the order form today with the June 1 billing start and 38 seats. Once it's signed, you'll get the kickoff invite for May 20 at 10 a.m. Central.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it over and I'll push it to Marcus this afternoon.
